text.en: Arrows fired quickly after a full draw become poison arrows. Precision hits with poison arrows stun the combatant and spread poison to nearby ones. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.
Arrows fired quickly after a full draw become poison arrows. Precision hits with poison arrows stun the combatant and spread poison to nearby ones. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.

Grants Lightweight Frame bonuses.

Intrinsically <overload/>Anti-Overload, but only the Poison Burst stuns <overload/>Overload champions. 

Arrows released within the Perfect Draw window apply poison on hit. Poison deals <pve 46 /> <pvp [2.5] /> damage every 0.25 seconds for 1.35 seconds, totalling <pve 276 /> <pvp [15] /> damage.

Precision Hits within the Perfect Draw window trigger a burst of poison in a 3 meter radius around the target.
